name: Missing Reward Channel
definition: An action surface exists with no reward attached, so rational agents will not allocate compute to it.
trigger_conditions: The behavior the system needs is not on any reward path
Agents are economically rational over standing or utility flows
Contribution and selection are rewarded asymmetrically
citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F006 Missing Reward Channel. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F006
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
